name: Sandin
title: Sandin Image Processor
body: Based on the Digital Sandin Image Processor implementation by Amanda Long.

name: RuttEtra
title: Rutt-Etra Video Synthesizer
body: Based on the Rutt-Etra-Izer implementation by Felix Turner

name: HSFlow
title: Horn-Schunck Optical Flow
body: Based on the HSFlow implementation by Andrew Benson.

name: DeeSeventySix
title: DeeSeventySix
body: Film chemistry simulation by Nick Fox-Gieg.

name: Yellowtail
title: Yellowtail
body: An interactive software system for the gestural creation and performance of realtime abstract animation, by Golan Levin.

name: UnrealBloom
title: UnrealBloom
body: Inspired by the bloom pass of Unreal Engine, by Michael Herzog.

name: VRML
title: Virtual Reality Modeling Language
body: Based on vrml-qtvr-viewer, whose parser comes from the three.js VRMLLoader.

name: SlowscanJam
title: Slowscan Video Emulator
body: Based on Cassette-Video-Encoder and Cassette-Video-Decoder by Kris Slyka.

name: Latk
title: Lightning Artist Toolkit
body: Tools for animated 3D drawings, by Nick Fox-Gieg, developed with support from the Canada Council for the Arts, Eyebeam Art + Technology Center, Ontario Arts Council and Toronto Arts Council.

name: Twoscilloscope
title: Twoscilloscope
body: Vector drawings to oscilloscope audio and back again, by Nick Fox-Gieg. It joins XYscope by Ted Davis and Oscilloscope by Hansi Raber at the audio. The drawing is made with the Lightning Artist Toolkit.

name: Skeleton
title: Zhang-Suen Thinning
body: Based on the skeleton-tracing implementation by Lingdong Huang.
